facts.name: Rocket Lab
sentences: Rocket Lab's shares moved 5% or more on 91 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 5 November 2026, when the stock fell 12.2%.
The stock is down 8.2% this year, and at $64.07 it sits 57.4% below its 52-week closing high of $150.23 from 27 May 2026.
$1,000 invested in Rocket Lab five years ago would be worth $4,459 today.
